setup: A [[service]] charges $[[base]] plus $[[per]] per [[unit]], and the limit is $[[budget]].

steps.say: Take the flat $[[base]] off the limit: $[[budget]] - $[[base]] = $[[room]] left for the [[unit]]s.
Each [[unit]] costs $[[per]], and $[[room]] / $[[per]] is [[quotient]] with something left over.
[[next]] [[unit]]s would cost $[[next_cost]], which is over the limit, so the greatest whole number is [[count]].
